deals.date_text: 14 July 2026 (terms agreed 3 December 2025; Stadion shareholders approved mid-June 2026; ACM cleared it on 1 July 2026)
deals.evidence: Feyenoord is vanaf vandaag feitelijk eigenaar van De Kuip, doordat het een meerderheidsbelang van meer dan 95 procent heeft in het Stadion.
deals.headline: Feyenoord takes over De Kuip with a stake of more than 95% in Stadion Feijenoord
deals.summary: Feyenoord subscribed for new shares in Stadion Feijenoord N.V. and now holds more than 95%, ending the split between club and stadium. Under the December 2025 terms the club takes 80,635 new shares for nearly EUR 3.7m and commits EUR 3-5m a year for ten years to stadium investment on top of rent; V-shareholders keep free seat rights for 15 years.

deals.evidence: de Club zich richting Stadion committeert om de komende 10 jaar jaarlijks € 3 tot € 5 miljoen beschikbaar te stellen voor noodzakelijke investeringen
deals.headline: Feyenoord commits EUR 3-5m a year for ten years to De Kuip
deals.summary: As part of the merger terms the club commits to make EUR 3m to EUR 5m a year available for necessary investment in the stadium for ten years, in addition to regular rent.

deals.evidence: in ruil voor een vergoeding van € 11,8 miljoen
deals.headline: Rotterdam pays Stadion Feijenoord EUR 11.8m to drop large concerts; Goldman Sachs stadium loan repaid
deals.investor: Gemeente Rotterdam (municipality), with a contribution from Feyenoord
deals.summary: Stadion Feijenoord agreed with the municipality to stop staging large concerts after 2025 in exchange for EUR 11.8m; with that money and a contribution from the club, the Goldman Sachs loan taken for the abandoned new-stadium project was repaid in summer 2024.

deals.date_text: Announced October 2025; postponed as of August 2026
deals.evidence: Feyenoord gaat nu, ergens tussen november en eind januari 2026, meer dan de helft van de aandelen van de Vrienden van Feyenoord terugkopen.
deals.headline: Feyenoord plans to buy back more than half of the Vrienden van Feyenoord's shares (not completed)
deals.summary: Feyenoord said it would buy back more than half of the VvF's 48.7% between November 2025 and January 2026, costing the VvF one of its two supervisory board seats. Fan media citing AD reported in August 2026 that new CEO Robert Eenhoorn had put the buyback on hold until after the transfer window; the VvF stake is unchanged.

founded_evidence: Opgericht in 1908 door vier enthousiaste jonge mensen uit Rotterdam-Zuid
name: Feyenoord Rotterdam
notes: Latest published accounts are 2024-2025 (year to 30 June 2025, published 29 September 2025); feyenoord.com sits behind Cloudflare and refuses scripted requests, so the report is cited at the PDF the club's annual-report page links (cdn.sanity.io). Figures there are in EUR thousands; record net result EUR 23.055m. No average attendance in the report (33,163 season tickets sold). Social followers are the report's 'more than 6.3 million' across all channels. VvF's 2010 entry and the roughly EUR 30m injection are from Rijnmond (fan media citing AD give 2012 and EUR 32.6m); the club's right to buy the VvF shares back at the original price is from 1908.nl; the VvF buyback was still pending in August 2026 (1908.nl, FR-Fans citing AD), so the 48.7% from the 2024-25 report stands. Chair Toon van Bodegom's term ends in February 2027. Bank debt: long-term loans of EUR 21.265m at 30 June 2025 (lender not named) and an ABN AMRO EUR 6.25m seasonal facility. No valuation or honours count found on a citable page.
ownership_summary: Feyenoord Rotterdam N.V. is controlled by Stichting Continuïteit Feyenoord (50.1%), the foundation that guards the club's identity and continuity. VVF B.V., the vehicle of the Vrienden van Feyenoord, a group of wealthy supporters who rescued the club in 2010 with an injection of some EUR 30m, holds 48.7% and nominates two supervisory directors; Feyenoord has the right to buy those shares back at the original price. Stichting Supporters Steunen Feyenoord holds 1.2%. A planned buyback of about half the VvF stake, announced in October 2025, had not been completed by August 2026. No fund, sovereign or other institutional investor holds shares.
